from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

doc = Document()
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.9)
sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.8)
st = doc.styles["Normal"]; st.font.name = "Calibri"; st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
for h, sz in (("Heading 1", 13), ("Heading 2", 11.5)):
    doc.styles[h].font.size = Pt(sz); doc.styles[h].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F,0x3A,0x5F); doc.styles[h].font.name="Calibri"

def shade(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); s = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    s.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); s.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); s.set(qn("w:fill"), color); tcPr.append(s)

def P(text="", bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, space=4):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space)
    add_runs(p, text, bold, italic, size)
    if align: p.alignment = align
    return p

def add_runs(p, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None):
    # **bold** markup support
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if not part: continue
        r = p.add_run(part); r.bold = bold or (i % 2 == 1); r.italic = italic
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)

def B(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2); add_runs(p, text); return p

def N(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number"); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2); add_runs(p, text); return p

def H1(t): doc.add_heading(t, level=1)
def H2(t): doc.add_heading(t, level=2)

def T(headers, rows, widths=None, size=9):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""; r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(size)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF); shade(c, "1F3A5F")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""; p = cells[i].paragraphs[0]
            parts = str(v).split("**")
            for j, part in enumerate(parts):
                if part:
                    r = p.add_run(part); r.font.size = Pt(size); r.bold = (j % 2 == 1)
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths): row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t
